verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API documents pairing and naming multiple Solo readers on a SumUp account, and its managed MCP server lets agents call SumUp APIs to manage the account. That covers reader registration only thinly, and nothing in the evidence shows any location or store entity that could be created via API, so the end-to-end provisioning flow is not shown. Missing for 10: API to create a location, linking readers to a location, an explicit API or agent tool for reader pairing, an end-to-end provisioning workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers

citations.quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.
Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later
